4.3.1.3.1 Initial Values
[SWS_Rte_06009]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00108
⌈For each data element in an interface specified with data semantics, the RTE shall
support the initValue attribute.⌋
The initValue attribute is used to ensure that AUTOSAR software-components al-
ways access valid data even if no value has yet been received. This information is re-
quired for inter-ECU, inter-Partition, and intra-Partition communication. For inter-ECU
communication initial values can be handled by COM but for intra-ECU communication
RTE has to guarantee that initValue is handled.
Please also note that in case of 1:N communication, it is possible to assign different
initValues to each VariableDataPrototype. But this will lead to resource over-
head since the RTE would need to allocate a buffer per configured initValue.
[SWS_Rte_06010]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00107
⌈The RTE shall use any specified initial value to prevent the receiver performing cal-
culations based on invalid (i.e. uninitialized) values when the swImplPolicy is not
queued and if the general initialization conditions in [SWS_Rte_07046] are fulfilled.⌋
